meta.title: Sidebar model and balance
meta.description: Shows the model used by the current session and your DeepSeek account balance above the Settings and account controls at the sidebar foot. Expand the sidebar to see it; the collapsed icon rail hides the card. The balance reads DSH's account snapshot and combines the topped-up and bonus wallet for the primary currency. It makes no balance requests before the active session has a conversation; after that it requests a fresh balance every 60 seconds and once more 3 seconds after each turn ends. It reads Signed out when no account is connected. Turning the plugin off removes the card and keeps the rest of the sidebar unchanged.
